title: Lead Full-Stack ERP/MES Developer
description:
**Chipmates Technologies** is establishing a state-of-the-art Electronics Manufacturing Services (EMS) facility in Chennai. We are deploying a custom ERP system tailored to high-precision SMT and box-build assembly.

We are looking for a hands-on Lead Full-Stack ERP/MES Developer with direct shop-floor

exposure to electronics manufacturing. In this role, you will initially work closely with our

external software development partner to co-develop, customize, and deploy our ERP

solution, take internal technical ownership, and train factory personnel.

As operations scale, you will lead our digital manufacturing roadmap—building and

heading an in-house software engineering team to design, develop, and integrate our

proprietary Manufacturing Execution System (MES) directly with shop-floor machinery.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Co-Development & Solution Architecture**: Collaborate closely with our external

technology vendor on database architecture, backend logic, APIs, and frontend

interfaces; conduct code and schema reviews to ensure system scalability and longterm

maintainability.

* **SMT & Shop-Floor Alignment**: Ensure ERP workflows match core EMS

operational realities—including multi-level BOMs, Job Work vs. Turnkey material

segregation, inward inspection (IQC), reel-level barcode/QR traceability, SMT work

orders, machine line scrap, and quality checkpoints (SPI/AOI/testing).

* **Future MES Architecture & Team Leadership**: Lead the technical strategy for

building our proprietary in-house MES; recruit, mentor, and manage an internal

engineering team to develop direct machine integrations (SMT placement lines,

reflow ovens, AOI/SPI testers) for real-time telemetry, OEE tracking, and closed-loop

process control.

* **Hardware & Tool Integration:** Implement native hardware integration for 2D

barcode/QR scanners, Zebra thermal label printers, and shop-floor data collection

terminals.

* **Internal Training & SOP**s: Create practical SOPs and conduct hands-on training for

stores, production lines, quality, and dispatch teams

Data Governance & Compliance: Enforce strict data discipline across departments

to ensure every transaction (material issues, line returns, scrap, dispatch) is captured

accurately in real time.

* **In-House Maintenance & Enhancements**: Manage system access, build custom

reports/dashboards, resolve technical issues, and lead post-launch feature additions.

**Candidate Profile & Qualifications**

* **Experience: 5–8 years in full-stack software development, with proven exposure to**

**manufacturing ERP implementations and architecture.**

* **Domain Background**: Prior experience working in or directly with an SMT /

Electronics Manufacturing (EMS) plant is essential. Understanding reel-level

component handling, PCB assembly stages, and Job Work inventory flow is

mandatory.

* **Leadership & Vision**: Demonstrated ability or clear readiness to lead an engineering

team, define an MES development roadmap, and bridge the gap between IT and

industrial automation.

* **Technical Stack**:

o Backend: Strong expertise in server-side development (Node.js, Python, Java,

or PHP/Deluge frameworks) and REST/WebSocket API design.

o Frontend: Solid skills in modern JavaScript (React, Vue, or Angular),

HTML5/CSS3, and responsive UI design.

o **Database**: Advanced SQL skills (PostgreSQL, MySQL, or MS SQL) with

expertise in schema design, queries, and optimization; familiarity with timeseries

databases for machine telemetry is a plus.

* **Hardware & IoT Integration:** Practical experience interfacing web applications

with handheld barcode scanners, industrial label printers, and shop-floor

hardware/PLC/machine protocols.

* **Communication & Training**: Strong interpersonal skills to manage vendor

discussions, lead developers, and train factory floor operators.

**What We Offer**

* Leadership role owning the complete digital operational engine of a high-growth

EMS facility.

* Clear career path from initial ERP rollout to building and heading the internal

software/MES engineering division.

* Highly competitive compensation based on experience and technical pedigree.

description:

The role focuses on GitHub Enterprise Server, GitHub Actions, self-hosted runner infrastructure, cross-platform build and deployment automation, and reliable delivery of on-premises software across Windows, Linux, and macOS environments, with supporting Azure services.  
This position requires strong technical ownership of automation, infrastructure reliability, release engineering, and deployment troubleshooting across distributed engineering environments. The engineer will work closely with software development, QA, IT, infrastructure, and global engineering teams to establish scalable, secure, and repeatable software delivery practices.

Key Responsibilities

* Design, implement, and maintain end-to-end CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Enterprise Server and GitHub Actions for multiple software products and repositories.
* Architect and manage self-hosted GitHub Actions runners across Windows, Linux, and macOS, including runner PCs used for hardware-dependent testing, integration, and deployment.
* Automate software build, unit testing, integration testing, packaging, artifact management, release, installation, and deployment workflows.
* Develop reusable GitHub Actions workflows, composite actions, scripts, and shared pipeline components to standardize engineering practices across teams.
* Design and maintain cross-platform deployment automation for on-premises applications, services, tools, and supporting infrastructure.
* Implement automated deployment, configuration management, environment provisioning, upgrade, rollback, and recovery procedures for customer and internal environments.
* Manage runner lifecycle, capacity, labels, groups, access controls, service accounts, credentials, connectivity, and job execution reliability.
* Build and maintain deployment automation using Bash, PowerShell, Python, and other appropriate scripting technologies.
* Integrate Azure services into software delivery workflows, including identity, secrets management, artifact storage, infrastructure provisioning, and monitoring, as applicable.
* Implement secure software supply chain practices, including least-privilege access, secret management, dependency and vulnerability scanning, artifact integrity, and controlled release approvals.
* Establish infrastructure-as-code and configuration-as-code practices using appropriate tools, including Terraform, Bicep, or equivalent technologies where applicable.
* Design CI/CD pipelines that support automated quality gates, test result publishing, code coverage, static analysis, security checks, and release readiness validation.
* Monitor pipeline health, runner availability, deployment outcomes, and infrastructure capacity; troubleshoot failures across GitHub, operating systems, networking, permissions, and application dependencies.
* Establish deployment observability, actionable logging, alerts, operational dashboards, and incident recovery procedures for on-premises environments.
* Manage release versioning, artifact traceability, environment configuration, release promotion, and deployment auditability across independently evolving software components.
* Collaborate with software and QA teams to improve build times, test reliability, deployment frequency, and developer productivity.
* Lead technical reviews, mentor engineers, document operational procedures, and drive continuous improvement in DevOps standards and practices.
* Work directly with global engineering teams during software integration, customer deployments, production issues, and release support.

Requirements:

* 7+ years of experience in software engineering, DevOps, build and release engineering, or infrastructure automation, with demonstrated technical ownership.  
  + Strong hands-on expertise with GitHub Enterprise Server, GitHub Actions, workflow design, reusable workflows, runner management, and GitHub APIs.
  + Proven experience configuring, operating, troubleshooting, and scaling self-hosted CI/CD runners in enterprise environments.
  + Strong experience with Linux administration, command-line tools, Bash scripting, and service management; practical experience supporting macOS build and deployment environments.
  + Experience with Windows environments and PowerShell-based automation for cross-platform software delivery.
  + Proven experience designing CI/CD pipelines covering build, automated testing, packaging, artifact publishing, deployment, and rollback.
  + Experience deploying and supporting on-premises software in enterprise or customer environments, including environments with restricted network access.
  + Strong understanding of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, TLS, proxies, firewalls, ports, and service connectivity.
  + Experience with Azure services and cloud infrastructure integration for enterprise software delivery.
  + Experience with containers and container tooling, such as Docker or Podman, and container-based development or deployment workflows.
  + Strong understanding of identity and access management, secrets handling, permissions, secure automation, and software supply chain security.
  + Ability to troubleshoot complex failures spanning source control, build agents, operating systems, networking, application dependencies, and deployment environments.
  + Experience owning infrastructure and automation solutions from design through implementation, rollout, and operational support.

This is a strong learning role: you will build real production troubleshooting skill on Java and Spring Boot systems, working alongside senior engineers who will guide and review your work.

  
  

Key Responsibilities

  
  

Incident & Service Request Handling

  
  

Act as first-line technical response for assigned Java applications — acknowledge, triage and resolve incidents and service requests within agreed SLAs.

  
  

Execute documented runbook and SOP procedures accurately for known issues and standard requests.

  
  

Perform initial diagnostics — check application logs, service and JVM status, job status, connectivity, disk and memory — before escalating.

  
  

Escalate unresolved or high-impact issues to the Senior Software Engineer or Lead with a clear summary of symptoms, checks performed and findings.

  
  

Keep tickets accurately updated at every stage and communicate status to users in plain, professional language.

  
  

Handle user access requests, data extraction requests and standard configuration requests per approved processes.

  
  

Monitoring & Proactive Operations

  
  

Monitor dashboards, alerts, batch schedules, queues and integration flows throughout the shift.

  
  

Respond to alerts proactively and take documented corrective action before users are impacted.

  
  

Run daily, weekly and month-end health checks and publish results to the team.

  
  

Track batch job failures, reruns and interface reconciliation, escalating exceptions promptly.

  
  

Perform routine housekeeping — log rotation and clean-up, archival, space checks and scheduled restarts.

  
  

Debugging & Defect Support

  
  

Read and interpret Java stack traces and application logs to identify the failing component.

  
  

Write SQL queries to investigate data-related issues and validate application behaviour.

  
  

Reproduce reported defects in test environments and document the reproduction steps clearly.

  
  

Fix simple, well-scoped defects in Java/Spring Boot code under supervision, with unit tests and peer review.
